name: tg-company-formation
description: Togo company formation and entity choice reference for 2026, covering SARL and single member SARL, SA and SAS, capital subscription and payment, legal personality and the official CFE incorporation checklist. Use it for créer une société au Togo, RCCM registration, capital social, statuts, incorporation fees and choosing between a limited liability and share company. The Guide applies the Togolese decree that permits freely determined SARL capital alongside OHADA company law, distinguishes paid capital from government fees and explains what the published CFE processing time actually describes. Annual tax, payroll and VAT duties are routed to their dedicated Guides, with unresolved notarial, banking, beneficial owner and live registration steps explicitly retained.
